poster_title: A Survey of Large Language Model Empowered Agents for Recommendation and Search
authors: Yu Zhang, Shutong Qiao, Jiaqi Zhang, Tzu-Heng Lin, Chen Gao, Yong Li
paper_info: ACM Trans. Inf. Syst. 1, 1 (April 2025), 30 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/nnnnnnn.nnnnnnn

panels.headline: First systematic review of LLM agents in recommendation and search systems
content: Addresses the challenges of traditional systems in handling complex tasks.
Focuses on the roles and applications of LLM agents in information retrieval.
Provides a structured taxonomy for understanding diverse applications.
Highlights the transformative potential of LLM agents.
Discusses unresolved challenges and future research directions.

panels.headline: The vast amount of online content has made it difficult to access relevant information
content: Online content complexity and scale pose significant challenges.
Recommender and search systems have evolved to address these issues.
LLMs have shown capabilities surpassing human performance in language tasks.

panels.headline: Traditional systems struggle with the complexity and scale of online content
content: Complexity and scale of online content challenge traditional systems.
Need for more precise and satisfying results in user interactions.
Lack of general understanding, reasoning, and decision-making abilities.

panels.headline: Fig. 1. Schematic diagram of the three core modules of agent
content: Establishes a taxonomy for categorizing recent advances.
Analyzes how LLM agents enhance recommendation and search systems.
panels.figure_caption: Schematic diagram of the three core modules of agent

panels.headline: Fig. 2. Illustration of existing work of LLM agents for recommendation and search
content: Reviews existing research and applications of LLM agents.
Provides a structured framework for understanding diverse applications.
panels.figure_caption: Illustration of existing work of LLM agents for recommendation and search

panels.headline: Fig. 3. Four domains of LLM agent's role in recommendation tasks
content: LLM agents play four key roles in recommendation tasks.
These roles enhance the performance of recommendation systems.
panels.figure_caption: Four domains of LLM agent's role in recommendation tasks

panels.headline: Fig. 4. Five domains of LLM agent's role in search tasks
content: LLM agents have five key roles in search tasks.
These roles improve the effectiveness of search systems.
panels.figure_caption: Five domains of LLM agent's role in search tasks

content: Lists representative works of LLM agents in recommendation tasks.

panels.headline: LLM agents have transformative potential in recommendation and search systems
content: LLM agents lead to the next generation of information retrieval.
Further research is needed to address identified limitations and challenges.
